# Module M-09: Read "stock not known"

## Lesson

You do this when a line shows no number for stock. When it works, the line shows "stock not known" instead of a number. [SC-09]

## Exercise

In the test environment, with its test data:

1. Confirm the order whose code is missing from the stock sheet. [SC-09 step 1]
2. Open it in the confirmation view. [SC-09 step 2]

## Check question

What do you do when it goes wrong?

## Answer

Add the code to the stock sheet; the next evening update shows the number. [CO-01]
